sentence: Stats screen in dark mode: the bars are barely visible.

reviewer_notes.root_cause_from_code: Views/StatsView.swift draws the per-day 'Total' BarMark with theme.color.accentSoft, whose dark value #4A2A22 sits on the card surface #1E1C1A at 1.33:1 (WCAG). accentSoft is designed as a chip/ring-track tint, not a chart mark. The completed bar (accent #FF8A6E) is 7.37:1 and fine.
reviewer_notes.expected_fix_shape: Add a semantic chart-track token to Theme.Palette (and the mirrored Assets.xcassets colorset) with a dark value >= 3:1 against surface (WCAG 1.4.11 non-text), use it for the Total mark. Do not repaint accentSoft (it is used for icon chips and the progress-ring track). Keep tabs, NavigationStack, fonts, radius 16/10, spacing untouched.
reviewer_notes.light_mode_note: Light track is 1.18:1 vs white; also below 3:1 but the sentence scopes dark mode. Preserving light appearance is acceptable; a fix touching light must be small.
reviewer_notes.static_review_note: Two BarMarks at the same x in Swift Charts stack by default; the intended 'track behind completed' rendering needs stacking: .unstacked. Cannot verify without Xcode; will flag.
